i ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT into as of December 31, 2014, among the NEW YORK CITY HOUSING AUTHORITY, a public benefit corporation established under the laws of the State of New York, having an office at 250 Broadway, New York, New York 10007 (the “Authority"); STANLEY COMMONS organized and existing under ArticleXI of the Private Housing Finance Law of the State of New York, having an office at c/o Good Shepherd Services, 305 Seventh Avenue, 9th Floor, New York, New York 10001 (the “HDFC"); and STANLEY COMMONS OWNER LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office at 16 Court Street, Brooklyn, New York 11241 (the “LLC" and collectively, with HDFC, the “SC Owner"), RECITALS: A. The ·Authority is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as Block 4375, Lot 50 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County, commonly known by the address 696 Stanley Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit A-1 attached hereto and made part hereof (said tax lot is Lot 50"). B．] Pursuant to a deed from the Authority to the HDFC, to be entered into after the execution of this Agreement and to be recorded after this Agreement, the HDFC will be the fee owner of the certain vacant parcel of land known as Block 4375, Lot 1 (to be known as Lots 1 and 60) on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County, commonly known as 670 Stanley Avenue, Brooklyn, New York and more particularly described on Exhibit A-2 attached hereto and made part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as “Lot 1"), and pursuant to a Declaration of Interest and Nominee Agreement between the HDFC and the LLC, to be entered into after the execution of this Agreement and to be recorded after this Agreement, the HDFC will be the record fee owner of Lot 1 and the LLC will be the equitable and beneficial ownerof Lot1. C. .A site plan of Block 4375 showing Lot 1, Lot 50 and Lot 70 the ("Merged Zoning Lot') is attached hereto as Exhibit B. D.The adjacent owner of Kings County Block 4375, Lot 70 (the “Lot 70 Owner") and the Authority: (i) entered into a Zoning Lot Development Agreement, dated May 30, 2013 and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York on June 20, 2013, under City File Registration Number (CRFN) 2013000242755,with Document ID 2013060401593006 (the “Prior ZLDA"), whereby the Lot 70 Owner and the Authority agreed to certain rights, restrictions and covenants. G.
